task_name: Add regression coverage and harden idempotency conflict

concerns_addressed: Verified idempotency conflict rule in order-to-payment pilot spec: same client identity with different canonical payload must return 422 and leave the committed order unchanged.
Confirmed OrderController shows no unrelated diff in the audited commit.
Confirmed duplicate replays still return the existing resource and leave history/stock intact.

strengths: Minimal hardening footprint limited to fingerprint creation, storage, and comparison plus the two regression test suites.
Public-boundary assertions used instead of internal mocking.
NULL-legacy fingerprint comparison safely falls back to persisted order items without destructive backfill.
Timing-safe hash comparison used for stored fingerprint comparison.
New migration is nullable and indexed; Order fillable addition is aligned with the persisted column.

issues.description: Task packet included OrderController in the modification list, but the delivered commit contains no Controller diff; scope is narrower than declared, though behavior remains correct.
One concurrency test uses sequential requests to exercise payment idempotency rather than a true parallel race, so it validates idempotency policy more than concurrent execution.
